description.texte: Corey Haines' marketing collection. Your agent identifies the task at hand—a page to convert, an email sequence, pricing or a Google Ads campaign—and applies the appropriate method.

interet.texte: Everything rests on a shared product document: you set product, audience and positioning once with product-marketing, and each skill rereads it before acting.
passages: Skills reference each other and build on shared context.

every other skill checks it first to understand your product, audience, and positioning before doing anything
